question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

If only **__I was young again__**.
solution:
Here, the correct answer is **"****I were young again​."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The sentence** "If only I was young again"** contains a grammatical error.
 
• The correct usage is to use **"were"** instead of **"was"** in this context.
 
• Using** "were"** in this construction is known as the subjunctive mood, which is used to express hypothetical or unreal situations.
 
• In this case, it emphasizes the wishful or unreal nature of the desire to be young again.
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

Correct sentence:* If only **I were young again**__.*
